language.label: Language
language.hint: The bot's chat texts stay in the language you picked during setup. Changing this only affects the interface.

data.title: Data and backup
data.description: Exports your StreamBuddy configuration including loyalty users and balances. Twitch accounts, tokens and runtime data are always excluded.
data.imported: Settings imported from {fileName}. Restart StreamBuddy to apply all changes.
data.resetDescription: Deletes all local settings, content, accounts and connections, then starts setup again.
data.resetConfirmMessage: This permanently deletes all local data, including Twitch connections, commands, loyalty accounts and statistics.

connection.twitchDescription: Sign in with your main Twitch account (broadcaster). This account is used for ads detection, sub events and follow events.
connection.missingScopes: The enabled features still need permissions: {scopes}
connection.modDescription: Optional separate account that writes in chat (commands, auto messages, loyalty games). If not connected, the broadcaster account handles chat.
connection.sameAccountWarning: Broadcaster account and bot account are the same. Connect a separate Twitch account as the bot for the separation to work.
connection.chatDescription: The channel the bot reads and writes in.

features.title: Features
features.description: Each feature only requests the permissions it needs when connecting.

channel_points.title: Channel points
channel_points.description: Manage custom rewards and react to redemptions. Note: Twitch requires a token from the broadcaster account itself to manage rewards -- a moderator-only bot account can react to existing redemptions but cannot create new rewards.

polls.title: Polls
polls.description: Create Twitch polls straight from the app and follow them live.

loyalty_follow_sub.title: Loyalty: follow/sub rewards
loyalty_follow_sub.description: Award loyalty points automatically for follows, subs and gifted subs.

ad_schedule.title: Ad break message
ad_schedule.description: Announces upcoming ad breaks in chat. Note: Twitch requires a token from the broadcaster account itself -- a moderator bot account cannot fetch this, because the token user ID must match the channel exactly.

activity_feed.title: Activity feed
activity_feed.description: Shows follows, subs, bits, raids and channel point redemptions live on the dashboard.

commands.title: Commands
commands.description: Chat commands with permission, cooldown and aliases.
commands.emptyHint: Create a command the bot responds to in chat.

form.triggerHint: The exclamation mark is added automatically.
form.whisperWarning: Sent as a private Twitch whisper and only visible to the sender. Twitch restricts whispers for many bot accounts -- be sure to test.

welcome.title: Welcome to StreamBuddy
welcome.description: A few steps and your bot is ready. First: which language would you like to use the app in?
welcome.botTextNote: The bot's chat texts will be created in this language at the end. You can adjust each of them afterwards.

appearance.title: How should it look?
appearance.description: Both can be changed later in settings.

connection.title: Connect to Twitch
connection.description: StreamBuddy needs its own Twitch application. Create it once in the developer console and paste the client ID here.
connection.clientIdHint: Pick the “Chat Bot” category, no redirect URI needed.
connection.botAccountNote: Sign in with your broadcaster account — your main Twitch account. In the next step you can optionally connect a second mod account for commands and auto messages.
connection.deviceStep1: The page {url} opens automatically in your browser.

modAccount.title: Connect a mod account (optional)
modAccount.description: You can use a separate mod account for commands, auto messages, and loyalty games. This way the broadcaster account only handles system messages (ads, sub events) and the mod account handles chat interaction.
modAccount.hint: This step is optional. Without a mod account, the broadcaster account sends all chat messages.

channel.title: Which channel should the bot follow?

features.title: What should the bot do?
features.description: Each feature only requests the permissions it actually needs. You can change this any time.
features.coreChatDescription: The basis for commands and auto messages — always on.

summary.title: All set
summary.description: Give your choices a quick check. “Finish setup” creates the bot texts in the selected language.

setup.restartHint: Walks you through every step again. No data is deleted.
